meta.decisions: 2026-11-13: AA contrast fixes, dark theme, border-input, action-* and tracking-caps added from the Figma palette; see README Accessibility.
meta.scale: 2026-11-16 (1.5.0): standard scale decided by judgement (owner: the Figma sizes were a designer mistake): 4px spacing grid, type scale 12-30, control heights 32/36/40 (44 on touch), radius 6/8/12, icon sizes 16/20/24, shadows only on overlays, motion tokens. 2026-11-17 (1.6, owner standard, issue #33): buttons 36 (40 on touch), fields 40 (44 on touch), labels 13/500, supporting text 12/16, section heading 18/26.

looks.name: Refined
looks.usage: Opt-in look (since 1.11), set data-cm-look="refined" on <html> next to data-cm-theme. Poppins like the default look (since 1.20; was Inter for interface text); neutral greys with darker supporting text (since 1.20; were green-tinted); the Commmerce blue (nav-badge) on counts, the selected tab line and, as a light tint, selected rows (since 1.20; was the neon green accent); dots on toned badges. Owner decisions: CRM /v5 on 18 Nov 2026, blue and Poppins on 20 Nov 2026.
